editorial:
You follow Mitch Rapp, a young guy whose life falls apart when terrorists kill his fiancée on a beach. Instead of grieving quietly, he trains himself into a weapon and gets recruited by the CIA. There he meets Stan Hurley, a gruff Cold War veteran who pushes him hard. The two are sent after a wave of random attacks that turn out to be connected to a dangerous rogue operative. The vibe is gritty and serious, with a revenge-driven hero who does not smile much.

The action is fast and punchy, and Michael Keaton steals scenes as Hurley with dry humor and tough love. Dylan O'Brien sells the anger and grief well, though the plot can feel familiar if you have seen other spy thrillers. Some twists are easy to guess, but the fight scenes keep you watching. If you enjoy Bourne-style action, this is a solid pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: By the end, Mitch Rapp tracks down Ghost, the rogue former trainee who stole a nuclear device and plans to destroy a U.S. Navy fleet. After a brutal hand-to-hand fight, Mitch kills Ghost and gets the weapon away from the ships. The bomb detonates harmlessly out at sea, saving everyone. Hurley, who was captured and tortured earlier, survives and returns to duty. Mitch earns his place as a full operative, ready for more missions.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spy thrillers and revenge stories.
